iq.label: Synthetic: the model drawn as IQ at one instant, written to SigMF and read back, then estimated by Welch. A consistency check of the synthesis, the SigMF codec and the estimator, not a measurement. A periodic chirp is drawn as a real sawtooth sweep, whose spectrum has lines at the sweep rate, Fresnel ripple and tails past its band edges; the model carries its smooth envelope, so bins near a chirp differ by design while total power agrees.

label: MODELLED: an L-band power spectral density built from closed-form signal spectra (VALIDATED against the textbook main-lobe widths and spectral separation coefficients), jammer spectra and a kT noise floor, reduced to J/S and effective C/N0 by the spectral separation coefficient. The jammer powers, timeline and front-end bandwidths are scenario inputs, not measurements.
not_modelled: spreading-code line structure (for example the 1 kHz lines of C/A): tones are scored against the smooth envelope
automatic gain control, quantisation, pulse blanking and notch filtering
the receive-antenna pattern toward the jammer beyond one gain figure
intra-system multiple-access interference between satellites of one band
GLONASS G1/G2, BeiDou B1/B2 and Galileo E6
a designed signal's emissions outside its transmit bandwidth: its spectrum is truncated there, so no out-of-band emission reaches a neighbouring band
a chirp's effect on the loop at sweep rates comparable with the loop bandwidth: its C/N0 uses the row-averaged spectrum

bands[].centre_hz.note: carrier frequency from the signal's interface specification

bands[].design.components[].offset_hz.note: component offset from the carrier (a frequency-division multiple access sub-carrier when non-zero)

bands[].design.components[].power_fracti.note: component share of the unfiltered power

bands[].design.in_band_power_fraction.note: fraction eta of the unfiltered power inside the transmit bandwidth, integrated numerically

bands[].design.tracked_share.note: share of the unfiltered power in the tracked component

bands[].design.tx_bandwidth_hz.note: transmit bandwidth of a designed signal; its spectrum is zero outside it

bands[].first_null_hz.note: first positive-frequency null of the unit-area PSD, located numerically

bands[].nominal_cn0_dbhz.note: un-jammed C/N0 of the tracked component: its power minus the noise density

bands[].psd_peak_offset_hz.note: offset from the carrier of the PSD maximum, located numerically

bands[].rx_bandwidth_hz.note: double-sided front-end bandwidth over which the spectral separation coefficient is integrated

bands[].signal_power_dbw.note: received signal power: the interface-specification minimum unless the scenario overrides it

bands[].tracked_power_dbw.note: power the C/N0 and J/S are referred to: the signal power for a plain band; for a designed signal the tracked component's share of the unfiltered power, P s / eta

iq.centre_hz.note: front-end centre frequency of the synthetic snapshot

iq.comparison.bins_compared.note: Welch bins compared with the model: away from tones and inside 90 % of the Nyquist band

iq.comparison.integrated_power_ratio.note: Welch total power over model total power across the band, tones included

iq.comparison.mean_abs_difference_db.note: mean absolute Welch-minus-model difference over the compared bins

iq.comparison.median_difference_db.note: median Welch-minus-model difference; the estimator's bias, near zero

iq.enbw_hz.note: equivalent noise bandwidth of one Welch bin, f_s sum(w^2)/sum(w)^2

iq.freq_offset_hz[].note: Welch bin frequency relative to the centre, decimated for the report

iq.model_dbw_per_hz[].note: model PSD averaged over the same bin

iq.sigmf.data_bytes.note: size of the .sigmf-data buffer written and read back

iq.sigmf.full_scale.note: sample magnitude mapped to the largest integer code: four times the RMS

iq.sigmf.meta.global.core:sample_rate.note: core:sample_rate written to the SigMF metadata

iq.welch_dbw_per_hz[].note: Welch estimate of the read-back IQ

jammers[].bandwidth_hz.note: occupied or swept bandwidth; zero for a tone; the matched modulation's main-lobe null-to-null width for matched noise

jammers[].eirp_dbw.note: effective isotropic radiated power toward the receiver

jammers[].off_s.note: switch-off time; null when on to the end

jammers[].per_band[].cn0_effective_dbhz.note: effective C/N0 with only this jammer, continuously on

jammers[].per_band[].in_band_power_fract.note: fraction of the jammer's power inside the band's receiver bandwidth

jammers[].per_band[].js_db.note: total received jammer power over the band's received signal power

jammers[].per_band[].js_in_band_db.note: J/S counting only the jammer power inside the receiver bandwidth

jammers[].per_band[].ssc_db_per_hz.note: spectral separation coefficient of the continuously-on jammer against the band, 10 log10 of the integral of G_s G_j over the receiver band; null when no jammer power reaches the band

jammers[].received_power_dbw.note: received jammer power at the antenna output, total over its spectrum: the input, or EIRP + receive gain - free-space path loss

jamming_kind_cross_check[].abs_differenc.note: larger of the J/S and C/N0 differences between the two chains; zero to rounding

jamming_kind_cross_check[].cn0_jamming_k.note: effective C/N0 from jamming::effective_cn0_dbhz with Q = 1/(R_c kappa)
effective C/N0 the jamming kind reports with its representative Q, for comparison

jamming_kind_cross_check[].cn0_spectrum_.note: effective C/N0 from this kind's spectral separation coefficient

jamming_kind_cross_check[].jamming_kind_.note: the jamming kind's representative Q for this jammer type, jamming::q_factor

jamming_kind_cross_check[].js_jamming_ki.note: J/S from jamming::j_over_s_db on the same link inputs

panels[].bin_width_hz.note: width of one emitted panel column after downsampling

panels[].f_max_hz.note: upper edge of the panel's frequency grid

panels[].f_min_hz.note: lower edge of the panel's frequency grid

panels[].freq_hz[].note: centre of each emitted panel column

panels[].peak_dbw_per_hz.note: largest cell of the panel's full-resolution grid

panels[].psd_dbw_per_hz[][].note: panel power spectral density averaged over the cell in power: noise floor, signals and duty-weighted jammers

panels[].row_duration_s.note: duration of one emitted panel row after downsampling

panels[].t_s[].note: start of each emitted panel row

receiver.degraded_margin_db.note: margin above the threshold reported as degraded

receiver.system_temp_k.note: T_ant + 290 K x (F - 1), F the noise figure as a ratio

receiver.tracking_threshold_dbhz.note: effective C/N0 below which a band is reported lost

recording.centre_hz.note: core:frequency of the recording's first capture

recording.comparison.integrated_power_ra.note: recording total power over model total power, in uncalibrated units

recording.comparison.median_offset_db.note: median recording-minus-model difference: the unknown scale plus any real difference

recording.enbw_hz.note: equivalent noise bandwidth of one Welch bin

recording.freq_offset_hz[].note: Welch bin frequency relative to the recording centre

recording.model_dbw_per_hz[].note: model PSD at the recording's frequencies

recording.welch_db_per_hz[].note: Welch estimate of the recording in its own uncalibrated units

seed.note: random seed of the IQ synthesis; the spectrum and C/N0 timeline draw no random numbers

step_s.note: duration of one waterfall row; every row is averaged over it

timeline.bands[].cn0_effective_dbhz[].note: effective C/N0 of the band over each row, every active jammer duty-weighted

timeline.bands[].first_loss_t_s.note: start of the first row below the tracking threshold; null if never

timeline.bands[].js_db[].note: in-band J/S over each row: the duty-weighted power of the active jammers inside the receiver bandwidth over the signal power; null when none reaches the band

timeline.bands[].min_cn0_t_s.note: start of the row with the lowest C/N0

timeline.bands[].tracking_fraction.note: fraction of rows at or above the tracking threshold

timeline.bands[].worst_js_db.note: largest row in-band J/S; null when no jammer reaches the band

waterfall.bin_width_hz.note: width of one emitted frequency column after downsampling

waterfall.f_max_hz.note: upper edge of the frequency grid

waterfall.f_min_hz.note: lower edge of the frequency grid

waterfall.peak_dbw_per_hz.note: largest cell of the full-resolution grid

waterfall.psd_dbw_per_hz[][].note: power spectral density averaged over the cell in power: noise floor, signals and duty-weighted jammers

waterfall.row_duration_s.note: duration of one emitted row after downsampling
